labels.symptom: Legacy binary XLS files cannot be opened.
Subtotals leave out the first data row even when the range is marked as having no header.
labels.root_cause: The subtotal command treats the first row as a header and ignores header:false.

labels.symptom: Chinese text in documents doesn't display or can't be typed correctly.
labels.root_cause: The bundled fonts likely have no CJK glyphs and there's no fallback font or IME support.

labels.symptom: Right-to-left layout is not available and Arabic text does not display correctly.
labels.root_cause: There is no RTL layout, bidi or Arabic shaping support.

labels.symptom: OpenDocument spreadsheet (.ods) files cannot be opened.
Opening or dropping another document switches it into the same window, so two documents can't be seen side by side.
On macOS, opening a document from Finder shows a 'cannot open files in this format' alert and the app looks frozen with no window.
labels.root_cause: winit does not handle the open-documents Apple Event or application:openURLs:, so AppKit falls back to NSDocumentController.

labels.symptom: Font weights other than Regular, Bold and Italic can't be used.
The macOS Dock icon is the wrong size or shape next to standard app icons.
labels.root_cause: The app icon isn't drawn on the standard macOS icon grid with padding.

labels.symptom: Icons for the same functions look different from one app in the suite to another.
labels.root_cause: The apps don't share a common icon set.

labels.symptom: Very large spreadsheet files (around 100 MB) cannot be opened or worked with.
Clicking on the canvas sometimes stops working.
Large lookups and recalculation are slow, and long dependency chains are wrongly reported as circular references.
labels.root_cause: Range reads copy values, exact matches scan linearly, and recursive recalculation treats depth over 2000 as a cycle.

labels.symptom: After inserting a chart the source cells stay selected, so pressing Delete erases the data instead of the chart.
labels.root_cause: Chart insertion does not move the selection to the new chart.

labels.symptom: The desktop app has no guided setup that finds the CLI and produces a working MCP configuration for an agent client.
labels.root_cause: The existing Agent Control dialog shows bare MCP commands without finding or checking the actual CLI.

labels.symptom: Desktop installs give no documented, reliable way to run the bundled CLI from scripts or agents without relying on PATH.
labels.root_cause: Windows, AppImage and Flatpak packages don't put the CLI on PATH, and macOS ships it as a separate download.

labels.symptom: Sheets cannot hold more than about one million (2^20) rows.
On Linux and Flatpak, Arabic interface text always uses DejaVu Sans and ignores fonts the user has installed.
labels.root_cause: The interface font is chosen from a fixed list of system font paths instead of asking fontconfig or looking in the user's font folders.

labels.symptom: Users with a Taiwan or Hong Kong system locale get Simplified Chinese instead of Traditional Chinese.
labels.root_cause: Only a Simplified Chinese catalog (zh.rs) exists; there is no zh-Hant one.

labels.symptom: There is no Arch AUR package for installing and updating the app.
The installer does not offer to add a desktop shortcut.
labels.root_cause: The installer has no optional desktop-shortcut step.

labels.symptom: There is no Preferences dialog, no ribbon customization and no macro/VBA support.
There is no opt-in way to back up, version or share documents on storage the user owns (NAS, Google Drive, OneDrive, S3 via rclone).
On Windows and Linux the window lacks the standard custom title bar and caption buttons, and there is no System Title Bar preference.
labels.root_cause: Window decoration handling not standardized to the shared custom title bar architecture.

labels.symptom: The macOS app shipped in the DMG fails strict codesign verification because of FinderInfo metadata.
labels.root_cause: The macOS packaging script leaves a com.apple.FinderInfo extended attribute on the signed app bundle.

labels.symptom: Resizing or deleting charts does not work as expected.
Tables do not grow when data is typed into the next row or column.
Documents cannot be printed or exported to PDF.
Arabic text shows as empty rectangles even when an Arabic font is selected.
Clicking Paste freezes the app instantly.
Cells can only be selected along a row or a column, not as a rectangular range.
Web users can't add their own fonts from a link or a file; only fonts bundled at build time are available.
labels.root_cause: The web build has no runtime font loading and reads system fonts from hardcoded paths that don't exist on wasm.

labels.symptom: The GETPIVOTDATA formula function is missing.
Some fonts that come with Windows are missing from the font list.
On Linux the AppImage shows the default Wayland icon instead of the app icon.
labels.root_cause: The Wayland app_id or window icon does not match the desktop file and icon in the AppImage.

labels.symptom: The cell border picker shows only text labels with no visual preview, and some options don't work as expected.
The Forecast Sheet command is in the ribbon but does nothing.
labels.root_cause: The command has not been implemented.

labels.symptom: Saving a workbook drops the printer settings part, so paper source, duplex and driver settings are lost.
labels.root_cause: The XLSX writer does not keep the printerSettings binary part or the r:id on pageSetup that points to it.

labels.symptom: There are no Alt-key sequential shortcuts, so the app can't be fully driven from the keyboard.
Opening and saving a workbook silently drops content the app doesn't model, such as external links, custom XML, form controls and OLE objects.
labels.root_cause: The XLSX reader throws away package parts it doesn't model instead of keeping them and writing them back on save.

labels.symptom: Standard Excel shortcuts such as Ctrl+Space and Shift+Space don't work.
On Windows the app exits right after the window appears with 'Parent device is lost' because the DXC shader compiler DLLs are missing.
labels.root_cause: Windows packages do not ship dxcompiler.dll and dxil.dll, so wgpu's DX12 DXC pipeline compile fails and the device is lost.

labels.symptom: A ribbon control and its label are clipped or spill out of their ribbon section.
There's no Print option.
There's no header and footer option, and headers and footers in existing xlsx files don't show.
Clicking Protect Workbook does nothing.
labels.root_cause: The feature isn't implemented and the button isn't shown as unavailable.

labels.symptom: Protected sheets cannot be edited.
Hebrew text shows as empty squares in text fields.
labels.root_cause: No bundled or fallback font covers Hebrew glyphs.

labels.symptom: On Windows 11 with DX12 the app fails to open.
labels.root_cause: The graphics setup defaults to the DX12 backend.

labels.symptom: There is no macro or scripting system for automating spreadsheet tasks.
On macOS the app icon in the Dock looks noticeably larger than other app icons.
labels.root_cause: The macOS icon artwork has no standard transparent padding around it.

labels.symptom: The interface can't be switched to another language, and function names are English only.
Ctrl-clicking an already selected column header doesn't deselect it and stacks a darker highlight each time.
labels.root_cause: Ctrl-click adds the column to the selection again instead of toggling it off.

labels.symptom: There is no way to set regional formats, so dates and currency always follow US conventions.
labels.root_cause: Locale is hard-coded to en-US instead of following a user or system setting.

labels.symptom: Editing a date cell shows the raw serial number instead of the formatted date.
labels.root_cause: The cell editor shows the stored integer value instead of the formatted value.

labels.symptom: DATEDIF returns #VALUE! for valid dates.
Formulas written with German function names and semicolon separators are rejected.
labels.root_cause: Formula localization supports only English and Spanish.

labels.symptom: UI font rendering and ribbon layout look different from the sibling office apps.
The font list shows only the built-in fonts, not the fonts installed on the system.
labels.root_cause: System fonts are not enumerated when the font picker list is built.

labels.symptom: Pressing Alt doesn't show keyboard shortcut hints (KeyTips) on the ribbon.
On Fedora, UI symbols such as dropdown arrows show as empty boxes and the title bar doesn't match the desktop.
labels.root_cause: The UI font lookup only checks Debian/Arch font paths, so on Fedora it falls back to egui's built-in fonts, which don't have those glyphs.

labels.symptom: VBA macros aren't supported.
Images can't be placed inside a cell so that they fit the cell's size.
Array formulas that return one value give #VALUE! in Excel after the file is saved.
labels.root_cause: The XLSX writer sets the dynamic-array flag (cm) only for formulas that spill, so Excel applies implicit intersection to the rest.

labels.symptom: On Windows the screen flashes whenever the mouse moves.
Users want cloud file storage and collaboration services.
Double-clicking a column header divider does not auto-fit the column width.
Sibling-app references still use the old name PrintCraft instead of PdfCraft.
On Wayland, the AppImage shows a generic placeholder icon in the dock instead of the app icon.
labels.root_cause: Wayland picks the dock icon from an installed desktop entry matching the app id, and a directly-run AppImage installs none.

labels.symptom: ODS files cannot be opened.
XLSB files cannot be opened.
The interface has no Chinese, Korean or Russian option, and Simplified Chinese text shows missing glyphs when a Japanese font is found first.
labels.root_cause: The CJK font fallback did not order faces by language, so a Japanese face could be used for Chinese text.

labels.symptom: Pictures can only float over a worksheet, not be placed inside cells.
Removing the borders of one cell leaves lines visible because neighbouring cells still hold the shared edges.
labels.root_cause: No Border did not clear the facing edges stored on adjacent cells.

labels.symptom: The Windows installer offers no option to create a desktop shortcut.
labels.root_cause: The MSI had no optional desktop shortcut component.

labels.symptom: A quick drag selection leaves only the starting cell selected.
labels.root_cause: The drag-start and release paths skipped applying the first and final pointer positions.

labels.symptom: On a protected sheet, commands such as clear, paste, fill and replace still change locked cells, and hidden formulas stay visible.
labels.root_cause: Protection was checked only in cell.set and not in the shared commit path.

labels.symptom: Inserting or deleting cells with a shift does not update the formula references that point into the shifted area.
labels.root_cause: deleteCells threw away the reference edit, and insertCells treated the shift as a move.

labels.symptom: Sheet-level defined names end up on the wrong sheet after moving, copying or deleting sheets.
labels.root_cause: Name scopes are stored as sheet indices, and sheet operations did not re-index them.

labels.symptom: Defined names accept R1C1-style names, Create from Selection ignores the bottom and right labels, and LAMBDA names show in upper case.
labels.root_cause: valid_name was incomplete, createFromSelection ignored options, and the parser upper-cases every function name.

labels.symptom: Formulas that use a spill range reference such as A1# cannot be entered or opened.
labels.root_cause: The parser did not support the spill operator.

labels.symptom: Switch Row/Column does nothing on charts loaded from a file, and scatter charts with text X values draw no points.
labels.root_cause: Charts read from files had no source range, and text X values were not replaced by indices.

labels.symptom: Splitting text into columns drops a doubled quote inside a quoted field.
labels.root_cause: The splitter did not treat a doubled qualifier as an escaped literal quote.

labels.symptom: Images and charts stay in place when the rows under them are sorted or filtered.
labels.root_cause: The drawing anchor's editAs mode was dropped on import and objects were never moved during sorting.

labels.symptom: In the web build, an ordinary edit crashes with 'RuntimeError: unreachable'.
labels.root_cause: std::time::Instant::now panics on wasm32-unknown-unknown, which has no clock.

labels.symptom: The macOS disk image opens as a plain white Finder window without a branded background or icon layout.
labels.root_cause: The DMG packaging had no background image or Finder layout settings.

labels.symptom: Linux users have no Flatpak build and AppImages cannot auto-update.
labels.root_cause: Release workflow lacked Flatpak jobs and AppImage zsync update information.

labels.symptom: In the web build, Print does nothing instead of opening the browser's print dialog.
labels.root_cause: The generated print PDF was discarded and never handed to a system print dialog.

labels.symptom: Cutting cells to another sheet leaves dependent formulas pointing at the emptied cells.
labels.root_cause: The reference adjustment ignored moves to another sheet.

labels.symptom: Cells keep old spilled values, or stale totals, after a dynamic array formula is overwritten or cleared.
labels.root_cause: Old spills were not cleared when a formula was removed, and ranges with function-result endpoints recorded too few precedents.

labels.symptom: Typing a new table header does not rename the column, and the old name comes back after saving.
labels.root_cause: Header cell edits were not synced to the table column names.

labels.symptom: The README Downloads section doesn't say where to get the app first and lists macOS builds before Windows.
Paste Special arithmetic overwrites text, errors and formulas instead of keeping or combining them.
labels.root_cause: Only cells holding plain numbers were combined; every other cell was overwritten.

labels.symptom: Sorting or selecting the current region of a large data set stops at about 10,000 rows and is very slow.
labels.root_cause: Region growth rescanned every cell in each ring and stopped after 10,000 steps.

labels.symptom: Fill or Remove Duplicates on a whole-sheet selection runs out of memory or hangs.
labels.root_cause: Whole-sheet selections were processed cell by cell instead of being narrowed to the used range.

labels.symptom: A jump-move command sent without a direction hangs forever.
labels.root_cause: A zero step vector never advanced, so the loop never ended.

labels.symptom: Creating a pivot table or a table over many repeated headers hangs the app.
labels.root_cause: Making header names unique took cubic time.

labels.symptom: COUNTBLANK and similar functions count too few blanks in ranges that extend past the used data.
labels.root_cause: Range references were cut off at the sheet's used range.

labels.symptom: Legacy array formulas show #SPILL! or don't fill the range they were entered in.
labels.root_cause: Legacy array formulas were evaluated like dynamic arrays.

labels.symptom: Formulas that read a blocked spill area show numbers instead of #SPILL! after recalculating.
labels.root_cause: A blocked spill was only detected at write-back, after later formulas had already read it.

labels.symptom: Combo and stock charts reopen as clustered column charts after saving.
labels.root_cause: The XLSX writer wrote these charts as a single column group.

labels.symptom: =MIN() with no arguments returns #VALUE! instead of 0.
labels.root_cause: MIN was registered with a minimum of one argument.

labels.symptom: A monthly date series that starts on the 31st skips February.
labels.root_cause: An out-of-range day rolled over into the next month instead of being clamped to the month's last day.

labels.symptom: Some chart types reopen as clustered column charts after saving.
labels.root_cause: The chartex and stock chart kinds were not written to or read from the file.

labels.symptom: On macOS, opening a document from Finder, the Dock or `open -a` shows an error that the app cannot open files in this format.
labels.root_cause: winit doesn't handle the kAEOpenDocuments Apple event that LaunchServices sends.

labels.symptom: On Linux Wayland desktops, dragging files from the file manager onto the window shows a prohibited cursor and nothing is dropped.
labels.root_cause: winit 0.30 does not implement drag-and-drop on Wayland, so the app has to run through XWayland.

labels.symptom: Opening a password-protected file fails with a confusing zip error or a blank document.
labels.root_cause: Encrypted CFB/OLE2 containers were not recognised and were passed to the zip reader.

labels.symptom: Opening a second document switches documents inside the same window instead of opening a new window, so two can't be viewed side by side.
labels.root_cause: The app has a single window and switches documents inside it.

labels.symptom: Dark mode keeps a light canvas, and on Linux the window has a separate system title bar.
After a sheet is renamed, formulas using a sheet-qualified defined name stop calculating.
labels.root_cause: rename_sheet rewrote only cell references, not sheet-qualified Expr::Name strings.

labels.symptom: Converting a table that uses a zero-numbered Light or Medium style to a range fails with an internal error.
labels.root_cause: Style number 0 caused an integer underflow in (n - 1) / 7.

labels.symptom: Clearing or replacing validation on part of a validated range leaves the old rule active.
labels.root_cause: Old rule ranges were removed only when the target fully contained them.

labels.symptom: Re-importing a one-column CSV splits cells that contain a semicolon or tab.
labels.root_cause: Delimiter sniffing picked the candidate with the highest total even when it did not appear on every line.

labels.symptom: In the web build, Export as PDF does nothing and no file is downloaded.
labels.root_cause: The UI ignored the base64 PDF that the export command returns when no path is given, and never passed it to the browser download service.

labels.symptom: Deleting the first or last sheet of a 3-D reference makes the formula return #REF!.
labels.root_cause: Sheet deletion only adjusted single-sheet references, not sheet spans.

labels.symptom: When connected to the desktop app, listing commands with a search term still returns every command.
labels.root_cause: The desktop engine.commands control handler ignored the search parameter.

labels.symptom: Headless open or save calls with no file path report success but do nothing.
labels.root_cause: In headless mode the queued file dialogs were silently dropped and the call returned null as a success.

labels.symptom: Saving as JSON fails with 'key must be a string' when the document has notes or hyperlinks.
labels.root_cause: Maps keyed by a struct type serialize to non-string JSON keys.

labels.symptom: Comparisons such as 0.1+0.2=0.3 return FALSE, and lookups miss matching numbers.
labels.root_cause: Raw f64 values were compared instead of rounding both to 15 significant digits.

labels.symptom: While renaming a tab inline, pressing Enter or clicking elsewhere neither saves the name nor leaves the field, and typing keeps going into it.
labels.root_cause: The inline rename TextEdit called request_focus() every frame, so it took focus back right away and lost_focus() never became true.

labels.symptom: The progress and parity docs are out of date.
Saving a macro-enabled workbook silently removes its macros.
labels.root_cause: The XLSX reader dropped vbaProject.bin and the writer did not write it back.

labels.symptom: The interface, formula names and regional number formats are available only in English.
On Linux X11 every window shows two title bars, with the window controls on an outer bar that doesn't match the app.
labels.root_cause: The system window frame is left on above the app's own title bar.

labels.symptom: Tables have no slicers for filtering.
The About window has no Contributors or Models tabs listing who contributed.
On Linux the System display theme always shows light, ignoring the desktop's dark mode.
labels.root_cause: winit's system_theme() returns None on Linux, so egui's System preference falls back to light.

labels.symptom: On Linux X11 the window looks zoomed in because it scales to the panel's physical DPI instead of the desktop scale.
labels.root_cause: winit uses XRandR physical DPI for the X11 scale factor while the desktop renders at 96 DPI.

labels.symptom: Commands given an invalid cell reference quietly act on the active cell, and sheet prefixes are ignored.
labels.root_cause: cell_param returns None for references it can't parse and drops the sheet prefix.

labels.symptom: An automation command that sets a cell without giving a value silently clears the cell and reports success.
labels.root_cause: A missing input parameter was treated as an empty string instead of an error.

labels.symptom: Large workbooks recalculate slowly, lookups slow down badly as data grows, and long chains wrongly show #CIRC!.
labels.root_cause: Recalculation was not topological, lookups had no indexes, and it ran single-threaded.

labels.symptom: In the web version, Ctrl+P and the Print menu item do nothing.
labels.root_cause: The PDF made by file.print was thrown away and never passed to the browser's print dialog.

labels.symptom: Double-clicking the fill handle can freeze the app when the neighbouring column has a stray value far below.
labels.root_cause: Fill-down probes rows one at a time up to a million-row cap.

labels.symptom: Selected columns can't be reordered by dragging their headers.
Clippy fails with new warnings on Rust 1.95.
labels.root_cause: New Clippy lints in Rust 1.95 flag some match patterns.

labels.symptom: In the browser build, the current date and time are always a fixed date instead of the real clock.
labels.root_cause: The clock was read only on native targets because SystemTime traps on wasm32, so wasm fell back to a hardcoded value.

labels.symptom: A selection scrolled under frozen rows or columns is still drawn on top of the frozen pane.
labels.root_cause: Each pane painted the whole selection, relying only on per-pane clipping in a shared coordinate system.

labels.symptom: Charts cannot be resized by dragging the corner handle, and typed width and height values snap back.
labels.root_cause: Drag hit-testing used the moved pointer position instead of the press origin, and DragValue fields were rebuilt from the model every frame, dropping edit text.

labels.symptom: Pressing Delete with a chart or shape selected does not delete it.
labels.root_cause: Delete and Backspace always cleared the active cell, even when an object was selected.

labels.symptom: On Windows with AMD graphics the app flashes briefly and exits without showing a window or an error.
labels.root_cause: The default wgpu instance also enables the OpenGL backend, and creating it crashes inside AMD's OpenGL driver.

labels.symptom: On macOS the Dock icon looks larger than the icons of neighbouring apps.
labels.root_cause: The full-bleed Windows/Linux icon was loaded on macOS instead of the padded macOS icon.

labels.symptom: Saving from the toolbar or the save-changes dialog drops a cell edit that is still in progress.
labels.root_cause: These save paths called file.save without committing the pending edit first.

labels.symptom: Version bump for the 0.5.0 release.
While editing a cell and scrolling, formula suggestion popups paint over the column headers and frozen panes.
labels.root_cause: In-cell editor helpers were clipped to the whole window instead of the worksheet area and frozen-pane quadrant.

labels.symptom: A small crafted document can use gigabytes of memory when opened.
labels.root_cause: The quick-xml namespace resolver had no cap on the number of namespace declarations per tag (RUSTSEC-2026-0195).

labels.symptom: Moving the selection by a huge offset through automation returns an overflow error or wraps the cursor to the opposite edge.
labels.root_cause: Cell offsets were added with plain integer addition instead of checked or saturating arithmetic.

labels.symptom: RISC-V Linux releases ship only a tar.gz, with no deb or rpm packages.
labels.root_cause: The riscv64 release job packages only the tar format and runs on ubuntu-24.04.

labels.symptom: A host page that embeds the web app cannot open or save documents in it.
Choosing Spanish as the language leaves the interface labels in English.
labels.root_cause: There was no Spanish UI catalog, so labels fell back to English.

labels.symptom: Numbers that are an exact tie at the 16th significant digit display one unit too high.
labels.root_cause: Formatting used round-half-to-even instead of truncating exact ties.

labels.symptom: Formulas like =0.1+0.2-0.3 show a tiny residue instead of 0.
labels.root_cause: Excel's snap-to-zero at the formula root, in SUM, in names and in LAMBDA bodies was not implemented.

labels.symptom: Japanese, Chinese and Korean text shows as empty boxes (tofu).
labels.root_cause: egui's bundled fonts have no CJK coverage and no system CJK face was added to the fallback chain.

labels.symptom: Wildcard criteria count blank cells as matches.
labels.root_cause: Text patterns also matched blank cells.

labels.symptom: Only the first matching conditional formatting rule is applied, and Cell Value rules handle blank cells and errors wrongly.
labels.root_cause: The evaluator stopped at the first matching rule and unknown operators were read as greater than.

labels.symptom: CHOOSE with an array index returns only the first choice, breaking the VLOOKUP look-left idiom.
labels.root_cause: The lazy CHOOSE path did not lift over array indices.

labels.symptom: Adds a contributor name entry.
Typed dates before 1900 are stored with the wrong year and typed times over 24 hours lose their hours.
labels.root_cause: Typed-input parser applied DATE()'s +1900 year rule and used a time format that wraps at 24 hours.

labels.symptom: Case-sensitive sort puts all uppercase words first, and Remove Duplicates compares raw values instead of the displayed text.
labels.root_cause: Text comparison used plain byte order and duplicate detection used underlying values.

labels.symptom: Tables don't grow when data is typed in the row below or the column to the right.
labels.root_cause: There is no table auto-expansion logic.

labels.symptom: Setting a cell's vertical alignment to top, middle or bottom does not move the text at default row heights.
labels.root_cause: The text y-position calculation gave no visible offset at the standard row height.

labels.symptom: Icon-set conditional formats saved to XLSX are dropped by other readers, and custom thresholds read from files are ignored.
labels.root_cause: The writer emitted iconSet with no cfvo children and evaluation expected one fewer threshold than icons.

labels.symptom: Turning on a filter with only the header row selected gives empty filter lists, and the filter menu has no search box.
labels.root_cause: A single-row selection was used as the filter range without extending it to the data below.

labels.symptom: In a selected range the active cell is shaded like the rest, so you can't see where typing will go.
labels.root_cause: The code that should clear the active cell painted a fully transparent rectangle, which changed nothing.

labels.symptom: The selection outline jumps to a new selection instead of gliding to it.
Formulas with an explicit @ are saved to XLSX with a literal @ that other spreadsheet programs may not accept.
labels.root_cause: The exporter did not translate @x to _xlfn.SINGLE(x).

labels.symptom: With many sheets or tabs open, the tab strip can't be scrolled horizontally with the mouse wheel.
labels.root_cause: The tab strip was not in a horizontal scroll area.

labels.symptom: Opening another document replaces the current one instead of opening a separate window.
German is not available as an interface language.
Clicking a ribbon button freezes the app.
labels.root_cause: A response query that locks the egui context was called inside a Context::data_mut closure, deadlocking.

labels.symptom: Adds a contributor name entry.
The odd-period bond functions ODDFPRICE, ODDFYIELD, ODDLPRICE and ODDLYIELD are missing.
On some Linux systems the app panics at startup with an error parsing a system TTF/OTF font file.
labels.root_cause: System font files were passed to egui without checking they parse, and epaint panics on an unparseable font.

labels.symptom: Ctrl-dragging the fill handle always copies instead of extending a series.
labels.root_cause: Holding Ctrl at release always sent copy mode.

labels.symptom: The PERCENTOF and EUROCONVERT functions are missing.
Typing a cell address in the Name Box and pressing Enter selects the cell below it.
labels.root_cause: The Enter key event stayed in the frame input and was handled again by the grid drawn later.

labels.symptom: Currency-formatted numbers pasted from other spreadsheets arrive as text.
labels.root_cause: Paste read only the plain-text clipboard and ignored the HTML clipboard format, which holds the underlying number.

labels.symptom: Review tab lacks Previous/Next Comment, Show Comments, Show All Notes and Convert to Comments.
labels.root_cause: Commands were not implemented.

labels.symptom: Context menu has no Insert Copied Cells or Insert Cut Cells option after copying rows or columns.
labels.root_cause: No command existed for inserting copied or cut cells.

labels.symptom: The GETPIVOTDATA function is missing.
The BAHTTEXT function is missing.
Clicking a button in a dialog that should open another dialog does nothing.
labels.root_cause: The dialog loop put the opening dialog back into the single dialog slot after drawing it, overwriting the dialog that had just been opened.

labels.symptom: There is no setting to make the interface text larger, so it looks small on 1080p screens.
labels.root_cause: Interface text sizes are fixed constants in the theme, with no user zoom preference.

labels.symptom: Showing the formula bar and zooming to 100% cannot be run from headless or automation sessions.
labels.root_cause: The commands existed only in the UI layer, not as engine commands.

labels.symptom: The TRIMRANGE function is missing.
Interface symbols such as arrows, check marks and ✕ show up as empty boxes, mostly on Linux.
labels.root_cause: The UI font chain had no symbol fallback face covering these glyphs.

labels.symptom: Recommended Charts inserts a chart right away instead of opening a dialog of chart types to choose from.
labels.root_cause: The button ran a command that inserted an automatically chosen chart without asking.

labels.symptom: After saving and reopening, threaded comments come back as plain notes and shown notes come back hidden.
labels.root_cause: The XLSX writer wrote only legacy notes, and the reader ignored the VML visibility flag.

labels.symptom: A line chart plots numeric X values such as years as a separate series, and the axis labels can't be edited.
labels.root_cause: The first column was used for category labels only when it held text, and there was no Select Data editing for categories.

labels.symptom: Cell checkboxes are hard to find, erase cell values when inserted, and are not saved as checkboxes in XLSX.
labels.root_cause: There was no ribbon button, insertion overwrote values with FALSE, and an invalid custom number format was written.

labels.symptom: PivotTables have no Calculated Field.
There is no way to keep ranges editable, optionally behind their own password, on a protected sheet.
Panes can't be frozen by dragging handles on the headers.
The interface is English only and does not follow the system language.
labels.root_cause: There was no interface-language setting and no system locale detection.

labels.symptom: Right-to-left sheets still show the first column on the left.
labels.root_cause: The grid ignored the right-to-left flag when drawing.

labels.symptom: PivotCharts can't be inserted.
On Windows PCs with Intel UHD graphics the app crashes silently at launch without showing a window.
labels.root_cause: wgpu's default instance enumerated Vulkan adapters, which crashes inside Intel's Vulkan driver, and there was no fallback when DirectX 12 can't start.

labels.symptom: On macOS a crash or error report appears every time the app is quit.
labels.root_cause: AccessKit restores the window's content-view class during teardown while AppKit's Touch Bar KVO observation is still registered on it, so AppKit throws an uncaught exception.

labels.symptom: The FORECAST.ETS functions are missing.
Dark mode is hard to find and the app always starts light, even on a dark desktop.
labels.root_cause: The default UI state did not follow the system theme, and the theme setting was buried in one menu.

labels.symptom: Many standard keyboard shortcuts from the original app are missing or wrong.
labels.root_cause: Only part of the original app's shortcut set was bound.

labels.symptom: The Data Analysis ToolPak is missing.
The app is not registered as a handler for file types it can open, so opening those files from the file manager doesn't work.
labels.root_cause: The desktop entry, MIME info and Windows installer associations were not updated when support for new formats was added.

labels.symptom: On macOS the red/yellow/green window buttons sit off-centre in the title bar.
labels.root_cause: The custom title bar was taller than AppKit's 28 pt title band, so the traffic lights were not vertically centred in it.

labels.symptom: Data › Forecast › Forecast Sheet is in the ribbon but not implemented.
There is no Solver to optimise an objective cell by changing variable cells under constraints.
labels.root_cause: The Solver command was not implemented.

labels.symptom: On macOS the app inside the release DMG fails strict code-signature verification.
labels.root_cause: The packaging script did not keep the app's strict signature when building the DMG.

labels.symptom: The File tab opens only a small popup instead of a full-window Backstage page with New, Open, Info, Save and Print.
labels.root_cause: The File tab was implemented as a short popup menu instead of a full-window Backstage view.

labels.symptom: Legacy .xls workbooks are refused when opened.
labels.root_cause: There is no BIFF8 reader.

labels.symptom: Saving a spreadsheet drops printer settings, custom XML and other unsupported parts.
labels.root_cause: Writer regenerates the package from the model, discarding unmodelled parts.

labels.symptom: Page Layout view only overlays page-break outlines instead of showing the sheet as printed pages.
Czech is not available as an interface language.
CI workflows are duplicated in every repo and raise Node 20 deprecation warnings.
After inserting or deleting rows, the copy marquee stays on the old position and a cut-paste moves the wrong cells.
labels.root_cause: The clipboard source range was not cleared or updated when rows, columns or cells were inserted or deleted.

labels.symptom: In the web build, Chinese, Japanese and Korean text shows as boxes.
labels.root_cause: A browser has no system fonts to fall back on, and no CJK font was bundled into the wasm build.

labels.symptom: Dropdown buttons show an empty box instead of a down arrow.
labels.root_cause: The ▾ glyph in the label is missing from the UI font; the fix draws a vector chevron icon instead.

labels.symptom: Resizing one of several Ctrl-selected rows or columns resizes only the last selected one.
labels.root_cause: Resize drag handlers resized only the last-selected area instead of every whole-row or whole-column area in the selection.

labels.symptom: Password fields in dialogs show the typed password as readable text.
labels.root_cause: The password was a plain text form field rendered without password masking.

labels.symptom: SUM over a very large dense range returns #NUM! even though the status bar shows the sum.
labels.root_cause: Ranges were copied into an array capped at 16M cells before aggregation, and then copied a second time.

labels.symptom: Copying a selection of several ranges does nothing and shows no message, so paste has nothing to paste.
labels.root_cause: Copy refused any multi-area selection, and the UI dropped the error without showing it.
bug_markers: This action won't work on multiple selections.

labels.symptom: Passwords entered in commands appear in plain text in the action journal, the automation channel and recorded scripts saved in the document.
labels.root_cause: The command journal recorded params as given, including secret password params.

labels.symptom: Copied cells paste into rich-text editors as plain tab-separated text instead of a table.
labels.root_cause: Copy put only plain text on the clipboard, with no HTML format.

labels.symptom: A ribbon button overflows and is clipped outside its ribbon section.
labels.root_cause: Four small buttons were placed in a three-slot vertical stack.

labels.symptom: Editing a date cell shows its serial number instead of the date.
labels.root_cause: The edit text ignored the cell's number format.

labels.symptom: Ctrl+clicking an already selected header or cell stacks another selection on top instead of deselecting it, so the overlay keeps getting darker.
labels.root_cause: Ctrl+click always added the area to the selection without checking whether it was already selected.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in French or German.
labels.root_cause: There were no fr or de translation catalogs.

labels.symptom: The Windows installer does not let the user choose the installation folder.
labels.root_cause: The MSI definition had no installation-folder dialog.

labels.symptom: Thai and Hebrew text shows as boxes even when fonts that support them are installed.
labels.root_cause: The font fallback chain only added CJK faces, so there was no Thai or Hebrew face to fall back to.

labels.symptom: Typing Alt ribbon shortcuts starts editing a cell instead of running the command.
labels.root_cause: There was no keytip mode to capture Alt key sequences.

labels.symptom: Text typed into merged cells disappears after the edit is committed.
labels.root_cause: Edits went to the covered hidden cell rather than the top-left cell of the merged range.

labels.symptom: Double-clicking a column or row header boundary does not auto-fit it.
labels.root_cause: The resize path returned before the double-click AutoFit handling could run.

labels.symptom: Context menus and dropdown popups stay open after clicking elsewhere in the app.
labels.root_cause: The dismissal check tested whether the pointer was outside all app UI instead of outside the popup itself.

labels.symptom: Cell text with both a rotation and wrapping is drawn flat, on screen and in print.
labels.root_cause: The wrap path drew the text and continued before the rotation was applied.

labels.symptom: Numbers in small fonts show #### in narrow columns even though they fit.
labels.root_cause: The digit width was measured once for an 11pt font instead of each cell's own font.

labels.symptom: Rounding to 15 or more digits leaves floating-point noise, so 0.1+0.2 shows 0.30000000000000004.
labels.root_cause: round_half_away returned the input unchanged when requested digits exceeded 15 significant digits.

labels.symptom: Line charts cannot be drawn as smooth curves.
Saved XLSX workbooks using LET or LAMBDA cannot be opened in Excel.
labels.root_cause: LET/LAMBDA parameter names were written without the _xlpm. prefix.

labels.symptom: Large sheets with many range formulas take minutes to open or edit.
labels.root_cause: used_range was recomputed on every range read, and dependent lookups scanned linear lists.

labels.symptom: SUMIF and AVERAGEIF give wrong totals when the sum range is smaller than the criteria range.
labels.root_cause: The sum range was not resized to the criteria range's dimensions because only its values were passed.

labels.symptom: DATE(1900,2,29) returns serial 61 instead of 60 as in Excel.
labels.root_cause: serial_from_ymd computed the real calendar date then shifted, never reaching the Lotus leap-day serial 60.

labels.symptom: README explains how to install the app on Gentoo from a community overlay.
Formatting applied to the whole worksheet disappears when typing into an empty cell.
labels.root_cause: New cells were created with the default style instead of inheriting the row/column style.

labels.symptom: Contributor docs tell you to run a CLI snapshot command that does not exist.
labels.root_cause: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md referenced a nonexistent cli snapshot subcommand.

labels.symptom: The document grid has no vertical scrollbar, even while scrolling.
labels.root_cause: The grid only drew a horizontal scrollbar.

labels.symptom: The desktop app writes no log anywhere, so users launched from a menu or Dock have nothing to attach to bug reports.
labels.root_cause: The desktop build never installed a logger, so log records were discarded.

labels.symptom: Releases are not created automatically when changes land on main.
There is no Flatpak repository to install and update the app from.
The interface has no Brazilian Portuguese option.
Array formulas exported to XLSX can compute different values when opened in Excel.
labels.root_cause: Array-sensitive formulas were exported without array metadata, so Excel applied implicit intersection.

labels.symptom: Text inside a worksheet text box can't be selected or edited.
labels.root_cause: Text boxes had no inline editor.

labels.symptom: Saved XLSX workbooks with a blocked spill cannot be opened in Excel.
labels.root_cause: #SPILL! and #CALC! were written as cached error values, which the XLSX format does not allow.

labels.symptom: CI workflows print Node 20 deprecation warnings.
labels.root_cause: GitHub Actions were pinned to versions running on Node 20.

labels.symptom: The font list shows only built-in fonts, and fonts installed on the system cannot be selected.
labels.root_cause: The font list was a hardcoded array, and egui panics on font families that were never registered, so installed fonts were never enumerated or loaded.

labels.symptom: No release builds are published for RISC-V Linux machines.
labels.root_cause: The release workflow had no riscv64gc-unknown-linux-gnu cross-compiled target.

labels.symptom: After clicking an item, pressing Enter or Space acts on the previously clicked spot instead of the current selection.
labels.root_cause: egui's Response::clicked() also counts keyboard Enter/Space activations, which were treated as pointer clicks.

labels.symptom: A screenshot timeout over the control server suggests a CLI snapshot command that does not exist.
labels.root_cause: The timeout message recommended an unimplemented snapshot subcommand.

labels.symptom: There is no System theme option that follows the OS light/dark appearance.
labels.root_cause: The theme was a persisted dark boolean with no option to follow the system.

labels.symptom: There is no visible File menu outside macOS, so New, Open and Save are hard to find.
labels.root_cause: File commands were only exposed through the macOS native menu.

labels.symptom: Formulas cannot be entered with Spanish function names or semicolon separators.
The app is not listed in the Omarchy app catalog.
